# ModelEndpoint

The customer's own OpenAI-compatible model endpoint: URL, model, key, where it runs, what it is for and how much each group may use.

## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spec.keyRef` | object (nullable) | No |  | The API key: a key of a `Connection` in the same namespace. Absent for a keyless in-cluster endpoint. |  |
| `spec.keyRef.key` | string | Yes |  | The key inside that connection's synced Secret. | min 1, max 63; pattern `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` |
| `spec.keyRef.name` | string | Yes |  | Name of a `Connection` in the same namespace. | min 1, max 40; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `spec.location` | string | No | `on-premise` | Where a model endpoint runs: in the customer's network, or at a cloud provider (prompts leave the cluster). | `on-premise`, `cloud` |
| `spec.model` | string | Yes |  | The model id the endpoint serves. | min 1, max 200 |
| `spec.purposes` | array of string | No | `["ask","agents"]` |  | min 1, max 2 |
| `spec.quota` | object (nullable) | No |  | Token limits; absent means no limit. |  |
| `spec.quota.perGroupMonthlyTokens` | integer (nullable) | No |  |  | min 1, max 10000000000; format `int64` |
| `spec.quota.perPersonDailyTokens` | integer (nullable) | No |  |  | min 1, max 1000000000; format `int64` |
| `spec.sendRows` | boolean | No | `false` | May query results (rows) be sent to this model? Off by default. |  |
| `spec.url` | string | Yes |  | The OpenAI-compatible base URL, for example `https://llm.internal.example/v1`. | min 8, max 512; pattern `^https?://` |

## Validation rules

- a cloud endpoint must use https
- each purpose may appear once
